requirements: Every new State type is private proposal metadata only, not an implemented ledger, storage layout, DB engine, write capability or recovery API. UUIDs, digests, receipt enums, owner/class labels and deserialized state never prove authority or actual persistence.

Node alone commits current domain state; protected helper independently owns per-pool admin secrets/approval/verifier state; clients write disposable cache only; workers write confined private spool only. Native runtime verifies actual principals, descriptor-relative no-follow traversal, ACL/mode/link ownership, trusted installation lineage, exclusive writer and storage generations. No path or stored label grants authority.

Resolve every transaction/effect/checkpoint reference under exact store ID, installation/device, generation, scope and immutable intent. Copied UUID/digest/receipt cannot join another store or cause execution. Owning domain keeps actual principal/RequestId/resource/payload dedup; conflicting reuse remains conflict. New metadata IDs never replace original signed row/act IDs or clocks.

Preserve exact signed transcript bytes, canonical hash/domain rules, original operation IDs and HLC/millisecond values, signature sets, nonces/expiry and original low-S/generic DER purpose distinctions. Never normalize historical signed envelopes or migrate legacy trust. Unsigned storage/transport whitespace is distinct; original canonical signed message must remain identical.

Board rotation requires complete validated signed base/carry restatement preserving original logical operation identity/hash/HLC, required archives and every security tombstone/proof. Never replace signed history with visible unsigned fold. Corrupt relay content cannot fabricate origin damage or discard trusted prior observations.

Derived views rebuild from verified immutable records plus durable nonderivable observations. Pins, head/conflict/damage/provenance, HLC highwater, cuts/distrust, first-complete timing, nonce/consumption and fatigue are not UI caches. Display labels can rebuild; acknowledgment rewind permits conservative authenticated resync only and never erases security observations.

Established missing/damaged critical store/root/checkpoint refuses, never defaults empty or silently becomes genesis. Genuine genesis requires independently admitted authority and explicit creation; reinstall preserves root and monotonic state. Restoration never resurrects removed incarnations, stopped work or old capabilities. Useful archived jobs/assets retain attribution without auto-execution.

One logical mutation serializes concurrent writers, validates current principal/resource/authority/store generations and applicable CAS revision, persists immutable intent and deterministic effect identities, and atomically commits authoritative group+consumption+receipt or an explicitly recoverable group protocol before acknowledgment. Single-file fsync/rename is not multi-file atomicity; rename/fsync/truncation uncertainty is recovery_required, never safe retry.

Cancellation and domain commit have one durable winner; accepted signed logs are not rolled back. External effects use separate durable prepare/consume/effect/reconcile receipts. committed/performed/reconciled are observed results, never authority to dispatch/replay. outcome_unknown reconciles the same deterministic effect before retry, including effect-before-receipt crashes. Performed requires verified durable effect evidence.

Crash recovery validates full commit group and applicable independent witness before serving/signing/dispatch/publication. Unknown process/lease/outcome holds safe custody until verified reconciliation; domain-authorized queued retry/resume is preserved under original policy/current authority, not blanket discard. PID or restored lease file alone is no live ownership proof.

First-seen/first-complete/awake observations are verifier-local monotonic facts. Never import remote/backup/cache timestamps as newly earned local elapsed. Process checkpoint earns no downtime; boot transition earns zero where retained clock requires. Backwards counters/clocks and numeric conversion/addition/revision overflow refuse. SETTLED is only separately admitted join history, never arbitrary negative local time or accepted helper-settled input.

Monotonic security state retains observed heads/epochs, every accepted signature set, cuts/revocations/distrust/disputes, key/root/installation continuity, first-complete clock basis, fatigue/notification/cancel and consumption/effect identity. Hashes/checkpoints stored in same rollback domain cannot detect whole-state rollback; StateProtectionDomainId is not proof of independent protection.

Witness proof must originate outside protected states rollback domain under the applicable threat boundary. Node/helper/witness clone cannot be claimed detected without a real backend proving it; do not build circular witnesses. Missing/inconsistent witness refuses. Privileged whole-device rollback resistance and actual per-OS monotonic mechanism remain explicitly unproved; same-account ownership/hash checks alone do not satisfy them.

No retention/GC of tombstones, commit/effect/consumption receipts, revocation cuts, consumed nonces or first-complete observations while any retained lineage/replay/effect may depend on them. Unknown dependency retains or refuses, never silently truncates. Existing retention floors/quotas and replay windows require explicit domain reconciliation; no bounds or budgets raised or grandfathered.

Settings/jobs/resource state remain local under their existing scoped ownership/generation/CAS authority. Replicated signed pool/board records do not overwrite local settings or grant leases. Content assets require digest plus current authorization/admission and cache hints never recreate settings/job/membership. Helper state, secrets and worker spools remain separate custody domains.

No total collection cap, arbitrary payload/path or state dump is introduced. Private metadata references complete opaque commit/checkpoint sets; implementation cannot truncate to fit. Existing per-domain complete authorized pagination/limits remain unchanged. This artifact selects no migration or storage engine and grants no runtime/K acceptance.
mechanism_limits: Current fsutil write_atomic and Log append/replace are source evidence of single-file mechanisms, not cross-file atomic receipt/consumption or platform ownership proofs.
GovPool saves acts/seen/refusals separately; phone marker hashes plus local files can be restored together. Independent monotonic witness and whole-group recovery backend remain unresolved.
Native authority store is inactive root-owned CAS foundation and explicitly excludes privileged disk rollback; it cannot stand in for a proven independent witness.
Current State::open missing-file defaults and Board::origin_of new origin on absence cannot authorize reset of an established unified store.
Existing approval decision-before-effects and partial grants require transaction/reconciliation implementation; this metadata does not fix or hide it.
Legacy Python settings/jobs and browser hints remain retained source behavior; native ownership and restart/custody implementation/migration are not supplied by declarations.

Signed transcript/rotation equivalence, monotonic observations, independent rollback backend, actual startup principal and all crash/cancel/fault interleavings require focused implementation proofs after reviewed common contracts.
